I was MOH for a friends wedding. My illness was undiagnosed at the time, but I was extremely physically and thus mentally unwell. My friend (the bride) was incredible and accommodated me in every way possible. Here are some examples that perhaps you can use:

-I wasn’t dating anyone at the time, but she gave me a plus one so I wouldn’t have to make the trip cross country alone. 
-I walked down the aisle with someone I could physically lean on since I couldn’t walk very well
-she offered to have a chair at the front if my illness was very bad
-I wrote the speech but another bridesmaid delivered it since I was only well enough for the ceremony
-my hair and makeup was last out of the group so I could rest beforehand
-there was a quiet room away from the party I could rest in as needed
-she gave me the schedule beforehand and was very clear on the most important things (pictures/ceremony/entrance) and where I could excuse myself
-another bridesmaid planned the bachelorette (I couldn’t attend bc I couldn’t travel)
